subject.title: docs: document replay history normalization contract

question: Should maintainers recreate the two compaction retry timeout comments on current main, ask the contributor to refresh this stale branch, or close the branch without replacement?
rationale: The useful remaining change is small, but the protected label, dirty merge state, and not-maintainer-editable branch require an explicit maintainer cleanup choice rather than an automated close or repair.

options.title: Recreate focused docs-only change
options.body: Add the two parameter comments on current main using the current `isCompactionRetryStillActive` name, run `git diff --check`, then close this stale branch as superseded.

options.title: Ask contributor to refresh
options.body: Keep this PR open for the author to rebase and reduce it to the current-main timeout-comment slice.

options.title: Close without replacement
options.body: Close the branch if maintainers decide the current source comments are already sufficient without the two parameter comments.

recommendation.title: Recreate focused docs-only change
recommendation.body: Add the two parameter comments on current main using the current `isCompactionRetryStillActive` name, run `git diff --check`, then close this stale branch as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this documentation branch and the recent compaction retry history that defines the small remaining comment slice.
